After School at Davidson Day School
Davidson Day School (age 2 - grade 12) - Davidson, NC (Lake Norman) - Parent-Facing
Deep Research Report
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Prepared July 2026. Hours, ages, fees, and
registration details change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
Executive Summary
Davidson Day's After School Care (Extended Care program) is a dependable, well-supervised option
for TT-grade 8 families, running 2:45-6:00 p.m. with a 15:1 ratio that meets North Carolina standards. It
emphasizes safe, nurturing care and homework support over a broad enrichment catalog - fitting its
smaller, community-oriented profile.
Strengths
• Clear hours (2:45-6 p.m.) and defined staffing/ratios (15:1, NC-compliant).
• Wide age eligibility, from toddlers through 8th grade.
• Structured sign-out/authorization for child safety.
Questions to Confirm on a Visit
• Pricing (drop-in vs. contracted) and late-pickup fees.
• Whether any enrichment classes or clubs are offered alongside care.
• Homework-support structure and snack policy.
• Options for Upper School students after dismissal.
Caveats
Based on Davidson Day's public Extended Care information (2025-26). Verify current hours, ratios, and
fees with the school (see Sources).
Sources & Where to Verify
Extended Care / After School Care: https://www.davidsonday.org/community/auxiliary-programs/extended-care
The Student Experience: https://www.davidsonday.org/the-student-experience
Contact: 704-237-5200; 750 Jetton Street, Davidson, NC 28036.

After School Pricing at Davidson Day School
Davidson Day School (TT-12) - Davidson, NC - Extended Care Pricing (checked July 2026)
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Deep web research performed July 22, 2026; the no-published-pricing finding below was re-verified 3-0 against the live school pages by independent verification agents. Hours, ages, and fees change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
Pricing by Grade & Days per Week
Davidson Day does not publish extended-care pricing anywhere on its live site. An extended care program exists - the tuition page notes "Financial Aid does not cover extended care," and a formerly indexed page described Before School care 7:15-7:40 a.m. and After School care 2:45-6:00 p.m. for Traditional Toddlers through 8th grade - but the dedicated Extended Care page now returns a 404 and the tuition page lists only 2026-27 tuition ($22,590-$26,910) and ancillary fees.

| Program | Grades served | Hours | Published cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Before School | TT-8 | 7:15-7:40 am | Not published - contact school |
| After School (Extended Care) | TT-8 | 2:45-6:00 pm | Not published - contact school |

Notes & Gaps
• Program details (TT-8 grade span, hours) come from formerly indexed content - the Extended Care page (davidsonday.org/community/auxiliary-programs/extended-care) 404s as of July 22, 2026 - so they may be stale.
• Extended-care sign-ups are reportedly released mid-July; contact the school for current rates and structure.
Sources & Where to Verify
Tuition and affordability: https://www.davidsonday.org/admission/tuition-and-affordability
Extended Care page (currently 404): https://www.davidsonday.org/community/auxiliary-programs/extended-care

After School at Davidson Day School
Davidson Day School (age 2 - grade 12) - Davidson, NC (Lake Norman) - Program
Overview
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Prepared July 2026. Hours, ages, fees, and
registration details change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
At a Glance
Davidson Day's After School Care (part of its Extended Care auxiliary program) provides a safe,
engaging, and nurturing environment for supervised play and homework completion for students from
Traditional Toddlers (TT) through 8th grade. Hours run 2:45-6:00 p.m.
Supervision & Safety
• Students are grouped by age and attendance, as determined by Extended Care staff.
• An Extended Care Coordinator plus two to four part-time staff supervise the program.
• Typical student-to-staff ratio of 15:1, complying with State of North Carolina standards.
• Students must be signed out by a parent or authorized person listed on the Extended Care
Application.
Context
As a smaller school in the Lake Norman region, Davidson Day's after-school offering centers on
dependable, well-supervised care rather than a large menu of enrichment tracks. Confirm any
enrichment/club add-ons with the school.
Sources & Where to Verify

The Student Experience: https://www.davidsonday.org/the-student-experience
Contact: 704-237-5200; 750 Jetton Street, Davidson, NC 28036.
